# Massimino

> Massimino is a safety-first fitness community where athletes and personal trainers log workouts, follow structured training programmes and connect, with moderation and anti-harassment tools built in. It is run by Beresol BV and its code is open source under the Apache License 2.0.

Massimino offers general fitness information and isn't medical advice. The site is in English. Workout logs, profiles and messages need an account; the pages below are public.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://massimino.fitness/): what Massimino is, featured training programmes and partners
- [About](https://massimino.fitness/about): who builds Massimino and what makes it different
- [Exercise library](https://massimino.fitness/exercises): 1,200+ curated exercises, searchable by muscle group, equipment, difficulty and movement pattern, with instructions
- [Fitness Intelligence](https://massimino.fitness/fitness-intelligence): European fitness market data (EuropeActive/Deloitte, FY2025) and physical-activity statistics from Eurostat, by country
- [Safety guidelines](https://massimino.fitness/safety): community rules, how content is moderated and how to report a problem
- [Community](https://massimino.fitness/community): community feed and discovery
- [Find a team](https://massimino.fitness/teams/discover): public training teams to join
- [Partnerships](https://massimino.fitness/partnerships): partner brands and how to become a partner
- [Sign up](https://massimino.fitness/signup): create an account

## Features (signed-in users)

- Workout logging: sessions, sets, reps, weight, RPE, personal records and history
- Training programmes: a catalogue of programme templates with subscriptions and progress tracking
- Massichat: an AI fitness coach
- Trainers and teams: public trainer profiles, coach and athlete management, invitations and challenges
- Assessments and nutrition: posture, cardio and readiness forms, and nutrition tools
